about.title: About Me
content: Hi, I'm Olympio — a passionate web developer who loves building beautiful and responsive websites.

I started my journey through self-learning, using research and tutorials to master programming. During college, I led my team to complete a thesis project that won "Best in Thesis," despite having no prior coding experience.

Today, I work as a frontend developer, specializing in creating user-focused interfaces that look great and perform smoothly across devices. I'm also passionate about business ideas, new technologies, and continuous learning — and yes, cats help keep me focused!
In my spare time, I enjoy watching tutorials, researching tech ideas, and finding ways to improve my skills and stay ahead in the field.
I'm excited to bring my skills, passion, and creativity to new projects.

items.title: Custom Website Design & Development
items.description: Stand out online with a stunning, responsive website built for your business goals. I design and develop sites that look incredible, load fast, and convert visitors into customers.

items.title: User-Focused UI/UX Design
items.description: First impressions matter. I create clean, modern interfaces that offer an effortless user experience — making it easier for your audience to trust, engage, and take action.

items.title: High-Converting Landing Pages & Business Sites
items.description: Turn clicks into clients. I build strategic landing pages and full business websites designed to capture attention, drive action, and grow your brand.

items.title: Award-Winning Thesis System
items.description: Successfully led a team project under extreme pressure, despite starting with no coding experience. Through intensive research and rapid skill development, delivered a fully functional system that earned the 'Best in Thesis' award — achieving a 100% project completion rate, on-time delivery, and recognition for outstanding innovation.

items.title: Responsive Business Website Concept
items.description: Designed and built a modern, mobile-first business website prototype. Focused on clean UI/UX and fast load speeds, achieving a 95+ Lighthouse performance score and 100% mobile responsiveness. Showcased how a strong design and user experience can increase engagement and drive business results.
